stem: A propagation work order calls for 50 cuttings, but only 46 donor shoots meet the supplied acceptance criteria. What should the technician do?
choices: Take four poor-quality cuttings to hit the target
Record the actual acceptable count and escalate the shortage
Change the acceptance criteria for this batch
Take four cuttings from an unlabeled donor
rationale: Meeting a numeric target does not justify violating donor acceptance or identity controls.
